_comment: CAPTURED from the Oura Cloud API on 2026-08-26, from the one real ring on
this project (stph.ctllo@gmail.com). Two records, verbatim, with nothing
edited except this comment key.
ADR-0026 is explicit about why this file is a capture and not a hand-
written payload: 'a hand-authored workout payload agrees with whatever the
mapper already believes, which is the one thing a fixture must not do.'
Until this file existed, every Oura test in this repo was written against
what the documentation says the wire looks like, and nobody had seen one.
Three things it settles that were open questions:
1. `activity` carries camelCase values like `strengthTraining` — not
snake_case, and not the HealthKit-style identifiers.
2. `distance` is null rather than absent on a workout with no distance.
3. `source` is Oura's OWN provenance ('confirmed'), which is a different
question from our CardioSource and is deliberately not read.
And one it settles by NOT containing it: there is no vendor string like
`com.ouraring.oura` anywhere on the Cloud API wire. That constant belongs
to the health-store transport only; the Cloud mapper hardcodes
`provider: 'oura'` because Oura is the only thing on the far end.
Both of these records are non-cardio, which is not a coincidence worth
editing away — it is the exact data that produced #102.
